verdicts.reason: A: a sensible left-to-right banner with a clear headline and CTA. But the 'NEW NIGHT SERUM' eyebrow sits below the body copy, which breaks the reading order. The logo is pushed to the bottom of the card, with the fig icon clipped by the card edge. The card runs almost to the top and bottom of the canvas, so it feels cramped. B: the Lumen & Fig logo has shrunk to an unreadable few pixels and fallen outside the card onto the leaves, so the brand is effectively lost. The bottle is cut off at the bottom of the canvas. The eyebrow also sits below the body copy, and the card floats at the top with an empty strip of leaves underneath.
